build_moe_module: build a LinearGlm4MoeLiteMoE mixed expert module with shared experts from a GLM4 config
run_experts_forward: run the experts_forward method to process hidden states through selected experts with top-k weights
route_tokens_to_experts: route tokens to experts using group-based top-k routing with sigmoid router logits and e-score correction
run_moe_forward: run the forward pass through the MoE module combining routed expert output with shared expert residuals
review_moe_routing: review the route_tokens_to_experts method for group-aware expert selection and normalized top-k weight computation
